origin.description: Take selected positions from every component of a theme list.
origin.details: which is 1-based. A short component is recycled out to the larger of the length of which and the greatest index in it.
origin.value: The same list with each component subscripted.
origin.example:
r <- Rows(list(col = c("a", "b"), lty = 1), c(1, 3, 2))
cat(r$col, r$lty, "\n")
